decision: Scans from Drive 'Nissan Frontier Pro-4X/Scans': Full Car + state scans (Front Bumper Removed, Front bumper Removed (Hood closed), Bumper and Hood Removed, Fender Flares Removed, Bumper Grille Mounting) + 'Frontier Grille' part
why: Brief: our scan data only. Skipped 'Frontier Accessories *' and 'Senta SR Frontier Fog' (aftermarket parts, not the stock truck)

decision: One rigid levelling transform for every scan (projects/nissan-frontier/tools/level.py, copied from huracan-evo; /home/user/media/nissan-frontier/level.json): RANSAC ground normal (0.044,0.024,0.999) -> +Z, long axis -> Y; nose already at -Y
why: Raw Artec frame tilted ~3 deg with the ground in the scan; one shared transform keeps every state registered (same role as prep --like)

decision: Ground/lift cleanup = drop tris below z=200 mm (levelled) and |x|>1200 mm (tools/clean.py) instead of ive crop
why: ive crop footprint was |x|<991 mm and clipped both mirrors (reach 1052/1084 mm). Truck sits on lift pads with no wheels; pads, lift arms and ground are all below ~200 mm, lowest real frame/suspension starts ~200-250 mm

decision: No wheels in any shot; wheel-arch close-ups show the scanned suspension instead
why: Full-car scan has no wheels (truck on a lift); never invent geometry (A90 precedent)

decision: State scans read by rendering each: 'Front Bumper Removed' = the removed bumper itself (fascia + grille + fogs), 'Front bumper Removed (Hood closed)' = truck front with bumper off, 'Bumper and Hood Removed' = exposed radiator support/core/frame front clip, 'Bumper Grille Mounting' = lower bar only
why: Names are ambiguous; looked at silver stills (chk/states.png) before planning the explode

decision: All state/part scans used at identity in the levelled frame (no ICP)
why: regcheck: medians to the full car 1.3 mm (hood-closed), 1.3 (flares removed), 2.1 (grille), 2.6 (grille mount), 3.7 (bumper+hood removed), 6.3 (bumper); ICP would only slide along the skin (median 6.3->5.7 at best); overlays chk/parts.png show bumper and grille seated on the truck

decision: Exploded parts: bumper = 'Front Bumper Removed' scan as captured minus the grille; grille = 'Frontier Grille' part scan; hood = full-car tris inside the hood shut lines (y -3440..-2270, |x|<830, z>1000 mm levelled, from a top heightmap) that 'Bumper and Hood Removed' lacks; flares = full-car tris 10-90 mm off 'Fender Flares Removed' on the outer arch zones (tools/parts.py)
why: Brief: explode from part scans + removed-state scans. No separate hood/flare part scans exist, so those come from the difference between the full car and the state where they are off

decision: Bases (tools/composite.py): comp_front = car minus hood/bumper/grille + new geometry from 'Bumper and Hood Removed' (front zone only); comp_explode = same + 'Fender Flares Removed' geometry in the four outer arch zones
why: Lesson: state scans as captured over the trimmed full car; zones stop the flares state's small door/bed offsets adding double skins
